mapper.sql: select o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.address_id, o.total_rent, o.deposit, o.status, o.pay_time, o.logistics_no, o.return_logistics_no, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark, a.receiver_name as receiver_name, a.phone as receiver_phone, concat(a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detail) as receiver_address from toy_order o left join toy_address a on o.address_id = a.id
